equity_bridge.item: Seasonal working-capital normalisation of net debt (half the Jun-26 vs Dec-25 swing)
equity_bridge.note: Jun-26 net debt 46,609 vs Dec-25 18,171 (FY2025 AR note 'Net debt' basis adjusted to exclude leases): swing 28,439, half added back so the deducted net debt is the mid-year level the unlevered annual flows are consistent with. See inputs.net_debt_note.

equity_bridge.item: FY2025 final dividend payable at 30 Jun 2026
equity_bridge.note: Interim balance sheet: dividends payable 2,409,956 (RMB'000), paid Q3 2026 to the pre-ex-date holders; a cash claim the Jun-26 cash still carried.

equity_bridge.item: Associates, JVs and financial assets at carrying value, after 34% NCI leakage
equity_bridge.note: Jun-26: investments in associates 10,862 + JVs 25 + FVTPL 595 + FVOCI equity 64 = 11,546 x (1 - 0.34) = 7,620. Share of associate profits (FY2025 1,233m; Shanghai Modern Pharma 13.88%, Yichang Humanwell 20%, both listed A-shares with stake market value at or above carrying) is OUTSIDE EBITDA and dividends from them sit in investing cash flow, so the asset enters the bridge (matching-asset rule). Haircut at the group NCI rate because the holding entities are not disclosed.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year revenue path average (-1% FY2026 recovering to 2.5-3%); equity CAGR rejected as the driver
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (7-8%) diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (1.4-4.7%) and EPS (-5.7% to 0%): attributable equity compounds because ~70% of earnings are retained at a 5.5x P/E, not because the business is growing. EPS has gone backwards over three years under VBP.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner series: reported OCF - capex - interest income - lease principal (FY2020 6,823; FY2022 16,276; FY2025 10,048). The series is dominated by year-end working-capital swings (FY2022 OCF 20,964 vs FY2021 9,308), so neither CAGR is a trend; the average FY2021-25 owner FCF is ~11.3bn. SBC is zero throughout, so the owner and reported series differ only by interest income and lease principal.

scenario_narratives.base: Sinopharm remains China's largest drug and device distributor through a multi-year policy squeeze. Revenue dips 1% in FY2026 and is flat in FY2027 as VBP batches 11-12 and 'red-and-yellow label' price governance shrink the generics base, then recovers to 2.5-3% as national-negotiated and innovative-drug distribution (+27-30% YoY in H1 2026), CSO/SPD services and prescription outflow to Guoda's specialty pharmacies outgrow the decline. Post-IFRS-16 EBITDA margin drifts from 3.53% to 3.25% because expense-ratio cuts recover most, not all, of the gross-margin erosion. Growth consumes 10% of incremental revenue in working capital, and 52.5% of EBIT leaks to cash tax and the 34% minorities. Terminal value capped at 12x attributable unlevered FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: The compliance/traceability regime (QR-code settlement July 2025, full traceability-code upload January 2026) and the 'no VBP for innovative drugs' price-formation reform turn Sinopharm into the consolidation winner: share gains and the innovative-drug mix return revenue to 4-5% growth by FY2028, Guoda Drugstore moves from a RMB217m loss to profit, and the CSO/cold-chain mix lifts EBITDA margin to 3.6%. Receivables discipline (balance already -2.8% YoY in H1 2026) cuts the working-capital toll to 8%, gearing keeps falling, and the market pays 14x terminal FCF.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 12th and later VBP batches, medical-insurance cost control and anti-corruption enforcement keep cutting both volume and spread: revenue falls ~8% cumulatively by FY2029 and EBITDA margin compresses to 2.75%. Hospital finances deteriorate under the macro slowdown, DSO lengthens further and ECL charges rise, so none of the working-capital release from a shrinking book reaches shareholders. SOE capital allocation keeps minorities' share of profit at 36%, and the H-share discount never closes: terminal value at 9x, the top of the stock's own 2016-26 range.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Sinopharm as a thin-margin, high-volume distributor whose cash generation is governed by three things the headline P&L hides: the working capital that every yuan of growth consumes, the 34% of profit that belongs to minorities, and the structural VBP compression of spread. Flows are attributable and unlevered in RMB, leases are an operating cost, the seasonal peak in net debt is normalised explicitly in the bridge, and the terminal multiple is capped at 12x because the business is policy-regulated and slow. The result is converted to HKD at the quoted rate. The house and street bases coincide (no SBC).
key_risks_to_valuation: Net-debt seasonality: the June and December balance sheets differ by ~RMB28bn (~HK$10/share); the mid-point is used and both extremes are stated in inputs.net_debt_note.

NCI leakage is modelled as a flat 34% of profit; if minorities are bought out or their subsidiaries outgrow the parent's, the leakage and hence value move materially (each 1pp of leakage is ~HK$0.35/share).
Working-capital capture at 10% of incremental revenue is the observed marginal rate; the 20.6% balance-sheet ratio would roughly halve the value of growth.

Receivables of RMB236bn (June 2026) at 130+ days against public hospitals: a credit event or further DSO stretch is not in the base flows beyond the recurring ECL and derecognition losses already inside operating profit.

Terminal cap of 12x FCF implies ~10x attributable earnings against a 5.5x current P/E: half the base-case upside is a re-rating the market has refused for a decade (the bear case, at 9x, is the no-re-rate value).
CNY/HKD rate is a point estimate dated 2026-10-09; refresh_price.py does not move it.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 14.55-22.34 HKD. CNYHKD=X at the same timestamp.
data_sources.financials: research/1099.HK/Reports/1099.HK_Metrics.csv and core_metrics/kpis (RMB thousands in the DB, millions here); FY2025 annual report (income statement, segment note p.149 for D&A, note 21 associates, note 32 pledged deposits, net-debt note); H1 2026 interim report (balance sheet 30 Jun 2026, cash-flow reconciliation, note 12 finance costs, note 20 borrowings, note 21 leases).
data_sources.qualitative: research/1099.HK/Reports/1099.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-12): VBP policy path, innovative-drug growth, Guoda turnaround, receivables and gearing guidance.

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,120,656,000 H+domestic shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (interim report, share capital note 19; weighted average FY2025 identical). No options, awards or convertibles outstanding, so basic = fully diluted; held FLAT (SBC-zero filer, nothing to charge twice).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report: no share option or share award scheme, no share-based payment expense in the cash flow reconciliation or the staff-cost note; financial-parser found no candidates. SBC-zero filer, rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and balance sheet in RMB (CNY); H-shares quoted in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1722 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-09T08:08Z (same timestamp as the price). Sinopharm Group has no A-share listing, so no dual-listing parity check is available; HKD is USD-pegged so the rate moves one-for-one with USDCNY. All per-share values computed in RMB then converted; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD.
inputs.net_debt_note: total_debt is interest-bearing bank and other borrowings only at 30 Jun 2026 (current 73,439 + non-current 4,215; interim note 20), lease liabilities excluded under treatment (B). cash is cash and cash equivalents only; the RMB10,839m of pledged deposits, restricted cash and term deposits over three months is excluded as it collateralises bills payable. The June balance sheet is the SEASONAL PEAK of net debt: Sinopharm pays suppliers in H1 and collects from hospitals in H2 every year (Dec-25 net debt 18,171; Jun-26 46,609; Dec-24 17,053; Jun-25 55,111). The unlevered flows exclude the interest on that seasonal borrowing, so the net-debt level consistent with annual flows is the mid-point, applied as an explicit equity_bridge add-back rather than by overriding the latest-filing anchor. Sensitivity: full Dec-25 basis would add ~RMB4.6/share (~HK$5.3), full Jun-26 basis would deduct the same.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. Cost of equity 9.0% = 10y China government bond ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x China ERP 6.5% (beta reflects 66% gearing on a defensive distributor; no extra SOE/H-share premium, that risk sits in the scenarios and weights). After-tax cost of debt 2.7% (FY2025 finance costs 2,495 on ~69bn average borrowings = 3.6% pre-tax; PBOC weighted loan rate ~3.0%). Weights 65/35 equity/debt on normalised net debt (~32bn) against parent market cap RMB39.6bn plus NCI at a market-consistent value. WACC = 0.65 x 9.0 + 0.35 x 2.7 = 6.8%, rounded to 7.0% and held identical across scenarios (risk charged once, in the flows).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal 1,986 + interest 175 = 2,161 = 0.376% of revenue; H1 2026 907 + 64 = 0.34%) charged inside adjusted EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path 0.36%, lease liabilities (RMB3,662m at Jun-26) EXCLUDED from net debt, and da_pct is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 PPE 1,772 + investment property 31 + intangibles 455 = 2,257 = 0.39%; ROU depreciation 2,032 excluded). EBITDA margin path is post-IFRS-16 operating profit + total D&A (FY2025 16,038 + 4,289 = 20,327 = 3.53%).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged ONCE, in the flows: non-controlling interests take 34% of profit after tax (FY2025 3,679 of 10,834; FY2024 32.4%; H1 2026 34.3%), folded with the cash tax rate into a combined leakage driver. cash_tax_rate_path = 1 - (1 - 28%) x (1 - 34%) = 52.5% in base (28% is the cash tax paid on EBIT: FY2025 4,741 on 15,909, above the 24.9% P&L rate because of withholding tax on subsidiary dividends and non-deductible ECL). No NCI deduction in the bridge; the associates/financial-assets bridge item carries the same 34% haircut. Calibration: FY2025 component EBIT 15,909 x (1 - 0.525) = 7,557 attributable unlevered NOPAT versus reported attributable net income 7,155, which is after ~960 attributable after-tax net finance cost, includes ~1,230 share of associates, and is after 576 of below-the-line impairments: 7,155 + 960 - 1,230 + 277 = 7,162 on a comparable basis, a 5% gap inside non-operating noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (dual currency, leases (B), NCI leakage in flows, matching-asset bridge, SBC-zero). Sinopharm is an operating distributor, not a financial: deposits/receivables are trade working capital, so the owner-FCF engine applies. WORKING CAPITAL: net operating WC (receivables 205.6bn + inventory 63.3bn - payables 150.2bn = 118.7bn) is 20.6% of revenue, but the observed marginal capture over FY2019-25 (OCF versus NI + D&A against 25bn/yr of revenue growth) is ~10%, because payables and bills discounting grow with sales; wc_capture_pct is therefore -10 in base (growth CONSUMES cash, distributor sign), -8 in bull, and 0 in bear where the release from shrinkage is eaten by lengthening hospital DSO (130 days FY2025 vs 111 FY2021). D&A: not in core_metrics; taken from the FY2025 segment note (annual report p.149) and the H1 2026 cash-flow reconciliation. TERMINAL CAP: 12x attributable unlevered FCF in base (structurally slow, policy-regulated), 14x bull, 9x bear = the stock's own 2016-26 range (P/E 5-9x, roughly 6-9x FCF), so the bear case is explicitly the no-re-rate case. FCF BASE: last_fcf follows the contract formula (reported OCF 14,138 - capex 1,604 - interest income 500 = 12,034; interest income stripped because the cash it earns is netted against debt in the bridge and the EBITDA build excludes finance income); last_fcf_after_lease_principal (10,048) is the lease-(B)-consistent figure the component build is anchored to. YEAR-1 CHECK: component FY2026 attributable owner FCF ~8.7bn vs FY2025 consolidated 10,048 less 34% NCI = 6.6bn plus after-tax interest add-back ~1.8bn = 8.4bn: consistent. Buybacks: none (treasury shares RMB3.8m, static); dividends RMB2,122m paid FY2025 (DPS RMB0.68, ~5.4% yield at the current price), so the flat count is a modelling convention the company funds through dividends rather than repurchases.

bear.rationale: VBP rounds keep compressing with no end point: revenue shrinks ~8% cumulatively by FY2029 and EBITDA margin falls to 2.75% (-22%); the working-capital release from shrinkage is absorbed by lengthening hospital DSO (capture 0); NCI leakage rises to 36%. Terminal cap 9x = the stock's own historical range, i.e. the market never re-rates.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -1.0% (H1 2026 -1.1%, no numeric guidance, VBP batches 11 and 12 still biting); flat FY2027; then 1.5-3% as innovative-drug/CSO growth (+27-30% in H1 2026) and share gains from consolidation outgrow the VBP-shrinking generics base, converging to 2.5% ~ China healthcare spend growth less price deflation.
base.margin_rationale: Post-IFRS-16 EBITDA margin 3.53% FY2025, H1 2026 3.23% vs H1 2025 3.38% (15bp YoY erosion; H2 seasonally ~30bp above H1). FY2026 3.38%, drifting to 3.25% by FY2029 as expense-ratio cuts (4.52% -> 4.11%) offset most but not all of the gross-margin decline (7.2% -> 6.7%); flat thereafter.
base.tax_rationale: Combined cash tax 28% and NCI leakage 34%: 1 - 0.72 x 0.66 = 52.5%. See inputs.nci_treatment.
base.capex_rationale: 0.28% FY2025, 0.22% annualised H1 2026, rising to 0.35% to converge on ex-ROU D&A of 0.38% (capex cannot stay below depreciation in perpetuity).

bull.rationale: Consolidation winner: revenue returns to 4-5% growth by FY2028 on innovative-drug, SPD and retail prescription outflow; Guoda turns profitable and CSO mix lifts EBITDA margin to 3.6%; receivables discipline cuts WC capture to 8%; NCI leakage eases to 33% (tax 27%). Terminal cap 14x: a modest re-rating toward sector peers.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% default because the downside axis is a single regulator (NHSA/VBP policy) with no visible end point, gross margin has fallen every year since FY2022, and 66% gearing leaves little buffer. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right (Guoda profitability, innovative-drug mix outgrowing the generics decline, and a market re-rating of an SOE H-share). Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
